output.summary: Attempt 2 after review 1 (Changes needed). Important 1: qualify() refuses a blocked install before the cache lookup (RUNNER_NOT_READY) and Claw prequalify skips blocked installs. Important 2: claudeModels resolves {models, hooks:null} when the CLI answered the models but closed or hit the 15 s timer without a listing. Minor: blocked text deduplicated; claude-profile.ts comment notes SessionEnd never reaches the stream; remote-job budget test reaps at 17 s; docs refreshed (solutions doc distilled to 12 s/18 s and hook listing, STATUS, 10-28/10-29 records, D28/D29). RED: 4 new tests failed (blocked qualified; models-then-exit and models-then-silence not unknown; duplicate hook text); 3 coverage tests (listing first, malformed entry, discovery failure not judged) passed from the start. GREEN: runner-qualification+runner-models+runner-settings+claude-controller+remote-job 66/66; typecheck exit 0; full npm test 1104/1104 exit 0 (09:49-09:50, load ~5-15). Real check: loadRunnerCatalog on this Mac with claude 2.1.280: hooks [], not blocked, 5 models, 1.8 s. Follow-ups left: discovery's own 2 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL, launcher step-1 hook check.

Story D28 (P2 (a), user 2026-10-30): claude role cancel/timeout grace SIGTERM->SIGKILL 6 s -> 12 s (runClaude), superviseRemote grace 12 s -> 18 s. Story D29 (P1 (a), user 2026-10-30): claudeModels also sends get_hooks_listing next to initialize and returns {models, hooks}; hooks null when the CLI does not list them. loadRunnerCatalog blocks claude (blocked + hint) when the listing has any hook or is unavailable; a failed discovery decides nothing. RED: claude-controller 'takes 9 s to release the lock' failed (lock left, 7.2 s); remote-job 'reaps within the stop budget' at 13 s failed (closed false, 12.0 s); runner-models/runner-settings 9 new or updated tests failed (no hook request sent -> 15 s discovery timeout, catalog not blocked). GREEN: claude-controller+remote-job 25/25; runner-models+runner-settings 28/28; typecheck exit 0. Updated the existing 'ignores SIGTERM' limit 8 s -> 14 s (12 s grace). Real CLI basis: docs/verification/2026-10-29-real-cli-runner-checks.md.

Independent report-only review (attempt 1): Changes needed, no Critical. Reviewer ran the 4 files 53/53 exit 0, typecheck exit 0, and confirmed RED by pairing HEAD 5bbcb18 src with the new tests (11 fail). Real claude 2.1.280 probe: both responses arrive in either order; unknown subtype -> subtype error; --settings hook listed as {event, source:flagSettings}. Important 1: Claw prequalify (src/runtime/live.ts:485) and qualify (runner-qualification.ts) ignore blocked, so a blocked claude can still be started on the host by the qualification fixture (its SessionEnd hook would run). Important 2: a CLI that answers initialize but never the listing makes the whole discovery fail, so claude is not blocked (runner-models.ts timer/close). Minor: stale docs (solutions doc 6/12 s, STATUS P2 open, claude-profile.ts hook comment), missing tests (listing first, malformed entry, discovery failure not blocked), remote-job test should reap near the 17 s budget, hint not deduplicated; discovery's own 2 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL and launcher step-1 hook check left as follow-ups.
